metadataRaw.title: How to Relieve Pinched Nerve Pain in the Hip and Leg (INSTANT RELIEF)
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to instantly fix sharp, shooting pains in the hip and leg caused from a pinched nerve.

These exercises will help quickly take pressure off bulging and herniated discs, the main cause of sciatica, and from muscle imbalances that can put pressure on the sciatic nerve pathway as it travels from the hip into the leg.

To get the best results, go through all the exercises and use what gives you the most relief.

Watch now and get instant pinched nerve pain relief in the hip and the leg!

0:00 Intro
0:42 Bed/Floor Exercise
2:56 Seated Exercise
5:18 Standing Exercise
